newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Rato sees good Jan economic data.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Rato sees good Jan economic data.

text.p: Spanish Economy Minister Rodrigo Rato said on Tuesday that January data will show a positive economic performance.
"The overall performance of the economy is becoming solid...January macroeconomic figures will be good" he told reporters at a tourism conference.
Rato said job creation was growing at the highest rate in Europe, and this pace was set to continue in 1997.
Responding to questions regarding the Bank of Spain's estimates for 1996 GDP growth compared to those of the Economy Ministry, Rato said the difference was unimportant.
The Bank of Spain today estimated 1996 GDP growth at 2.2 percent, while Rato estimated it was 2.3 percent.
